purpose: Independent audit measurements for COMBINE_CORNERS_AUDIT_report.md — re-derivation of the combine-corner investigation's claims on the preserved products. Diagnostic instrument (sanctioned): astropy memmap box medians, green channel, values x65535 to match Siril stat scale.

validation.method: reader cross-validated against the session's own Siril stat record (regional_stat_cov13.json): all 5 regions x 3 channels reproduced to <=0.1; box coords are Siril-crop coords (y from the canvas's high-row edge), the mapping the registry's y-flip guard covers

corner_marches_G_pct_vs_midfield.method: 100 px box medians stepping diagonally inward from each crop/canvas corner (corner labels = Siril-coord convention, c00 = siril(0,0) = the records' 'TL'); percent vs the median of six 200 px mid-field boxes

coverage_boundary_geometry.method: coverage read along the outward diagonal from each full-coverage crop corner on the covmaps; distance (px) at which coverage first falls to <= m members. Map contract measured on disk: values are k/n_members normalized to 1.0 at full coverage (13 discrete steps of 1/13 on covmap_aug06x3) — NOT the value/1000 the coverage_probe.sh docstring states
coverage_boundary_geometry.mapcrop_verification: both Siril-cropped map crops (sessions/aug06/work/covcrop/mapcrop_*.fit) read min == max == 1.0 across the full crop: full coverage everywhere, session guard re-verified
coverage_boundary_geometry.reading: the anomalous corners (cov13 c00: 8 member edges within 40 px; cov28 c00: 12 within 110 px) are exactly where the linear excess concentrates; quiet corners (one member edge at the corner, next 130-225 px out) show <1% anomalies — n=8 corners, consistent direction

same_sky_cross_arm_excess_pct.method: 200 px box medians at probe points defined on the combine crop, mapped to every other arm through each product's solved TAN-SIP WCS (the *_wcs.fit surfaces; astropy WCS naxis=2); excess = box/mean(3 same-sky flanks) - 1, computed within each arm; flank-choice systematic ~+/-0.3-0.5% (real structure), largely common-mode across arms at identical sky

probeA_cov13_c00_corner.note: at (0,0) the corner sky maps OUTSIDE set-01/set-02's per-set canvases (their -framing=min composes discard it) — the sub-stacks cover it, the per-set finals do not
probeA_cov13_c00_corner.combine_specific_increment: cov13 minus per-set mean at identical sky: +1.2, +0.8, +0.9, +0.9, +0.3 — a ~+1% combine-introduced term over the first ~300 px, decaying by 500 px, on top of +1-2% real sky structure

probeB_cov28_c00_patch.reading: the 150-350 px patch is +1.4-2.1% in EVERY per-set control at identical sky = predominantly REAL structure; six-member-specific increment vs cov13 is +0.3-0.4% (vs the prior session's +0.94% at n=1, position not exactly reconstructible — i450 products deleted, solve record carries no full WCS); at the corner itself the combine-specific term is again ~+1% (cov28 +0.17 where per-set truth reads -0.8 to -1.5)

member_sky_levels_G.method: central 400 px box median, green, raw sub-stacks on disk (pre-normalization; centers sample slightly different sky per member — level differences dominate); exposure identical 2.5 s both nights (LIVETIME/STACKCNT)
member_sky_levels_G.reading: night medians ~124 vs ~197: the two nights' per-frame sky differs ~60%, not the '~6%' recorded as the nbstack justification; aug06 set-01's own members span 122-208 within one set

display_amplification_inputs.law: registered measured mechanism (docs/dead-ends.md): autostretch amplification of a fractional background residual scales ~sqrt(sky x N)
display_amplification_inputs.inputs_verified: sky medians from the validated reads (cov13 75.1, cov28 63.7, set03 49.0 on the _spcc surfaces the stretch consumes); N from STACKCNT headers (1454, 2954, 456-500 per set)
display_amplification_inputs.arithmetic: combines render 2.1-2.2x and 2.8-2.9x a set-03-class surface's amplification; per-set surfaces sit at 1.0-1.2x on the same reference

july31_4set_control.method: same instrument + mapping as the aug06 probes, on web/results/july31/stack_set-01+02+03+04_full (17 sub-stacks, 1760 frames, -framing=min, built on the identical post-revert chain and byte-identical compose algorithm; members + sky flats all post-revert rebuilds); all four canvas corners probed vs the four per-set stacks at identical sky
july31_4set_control.combine_specific_increment_pct: 0.0-0.2 at every corner (combine minus per-set controls at identical sky) - CLEAN, vs the aug06 twins' +0.8-1.3
july31_4set_control.per_set_controls_note: per-set arms agree with the combine to ~0.1-0.2 at every point; member families still differ ~1% at the same sky (s04 vs s01-03 at c00) - dispersion exists, the min-framed product does not reach it

corner_position_geometry.method: combine corner positions mapped through the WCS into each member set's per-set canvas; minimum distance (px) to that canvas's edge, negative = outside it
corner_position_geometry.reading: three of four max+covcrop corners lie OUTSIDE at least one per-set canvas (the member-edge drift band); every min-framing corner lies inside all per-set canvases - the zone the corner term lives in is shipped by the max+covcrop route and never by min
